# Crypto DeFi Skills

Fourteen independent DeFi skill packs; 26 current skills. Official tools, portable instructions and source-backed workflows.

- [infra](https://github.com/galleonlabs/crypto-defi-skills/tree/main/packages/infra): RPC, wallet access, Alchemy, Coinbase and Hermes tool configuration
- [data](https://github.com/galleonlabs/crypto-defi-skills/tree/main/packages/data): CoinGecko, DeFiLlama, AIXBT and source-aware cross-protocol evidence
- [lp](https://github.com/galleonlabs/crypto-defi-skills/tree/main/packages/lp): Uniswap, Aerodrome, Curve, Balancer, Revert and VFAT liquidity workflows
- [hyperliquid](https://github.com/galleonlabs/crypto-defi-skills/tree/main/packages/hyperliquid): Spot, perps, HIP-3, account modes, execution and review
- [lending](https://github.com/galleonlabs/crypto-defi-skills/tree/main/packages/lending): Aave, Morpho, Compound, Euler, Spark and Solana lending
- [staking](https://github.com/galleonlabs/crypto-defi-skills/tree/main/packages/staking): Lido, Rocket Pool, EigenLayer and Symbiotic staking and exits
- [yield](https://github.com/galleonlabs/crypto-defi-skills/tree/main/packages/yield): Vaults, Pendle PT/YT, Yearn, Spark savings and Ethena
- [tokenized-assets](https://github.com/galleonlabs/crypto-defi-skills/tree/main/packages/tokenized-assets): Ondo and OpenEden eligibility, issuer risk and settlement
- [routing](https://github.com/galleonlabs/crypto-defi-skills/tree/main/packages/routing): 0x, 1inch, CoW, Jupiter, LI.FI, Relay, Across and CCTP
- [derivatives](https://github.com/galleonlabs/crypto-defi-skills/tree/main/packages/derivatives): GMX, Derive, Drift and Pendle Boros trading lifecycles
- [portfolio](https://github.com/galleonlabs/crypto-defi-skills/tree/main/packages/portfolio): Positions, liabilities, net exposure, cash flows and performance
- [security](https://github.com/galleonlabs/crypto-defi-skills/tree/main/packages/security): Token diligence, transaction decoding, permissions and simulation review
- [payments](https://github.com/galleonlabs/crypto-defi-skills/tree/main/packages/payments): Stablecoin transfers, x402, Sablier and Superfluid
- [governance](https://github.com/galleonlabs/crypto-defi-skills/tree/main/packages/governance): Snapshot, Cactus, Governor, voting and Safe execution

- [Research and verification](docs/research/report-source.md)
- [Hermes onboarding: Boomkin](https://github.com/galleonlabs/boomkin)
- [Independent releases](RELEASING.md)

Install one skill or any selected packs. No signer, subscription or financial authority is supplied by installation.
